name: Aperio Google
author: Aperio Contributors
description: Bundled adapter for Google Calendar, Google Tasks and Google People (Contacts).

en.account.client_id.hint: From your Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID, type "Desktop App"). Aperio needs your own client ID until it ships its own verified Google app registration.
en.account.client_id.label: Google OAuth client ID
en.account.client_secret.hint: Sits right under the client ID in the same Cloud Console entry. Despite the name, Google's own docs concede the secret isn't actually secret for Desktop apps — Aperio keeps it in the system keychain all the same.
en.account.client_secret.label: Google OAuth client secret

de.account.client_id.hint: Aus deiner Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID, Typ „Desktop App"). Eine eigene Client-ID ist notwendig, weil Aperio noch keine verifizierte Google-App-Registrierung hat.
de.account.client_id.label: Google OAuth Client-ID
de.account.client_secret.hint: Direkt unter der Client-ID in der Cloud Console. Trotz „Secret" laut Google für Desktop-Apps nicht wirklich geheim — wird trotzdem im Schlüsselbund des Systems abgelegt.
de.account.client_secret.label: Google OAuth Client-Secret
